summary: IndicFinance full-stack testing complete. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests PASS covering auth (register+seed, login, wrong-password 401, /me, language update), dashboard summary shape/math, transactions CRUD with balance updates & soft-delete reversal, budgets with computed spent, goals with add-money, and AI assistant chat + history. Frontend: onboarding language picker (6 Indic languages), register → auto-seeded dashboard, login with aarav@test.com, dashboard (balance hero, income/expense, donut chart, recent txns), Transactions tab (search + filter chips + 12 seeded txns + FAB), Budgets tab (4 budgets w/ progress + 3 goals), AI Assistant (sends message and gets contextual Hindi reply from gpt-5.4), and Settings screen — all render correctly and are fully localized in Hindi. One non-fatal web-preview bug detected: DonutChart triggers Console Error 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' via react-native-svg on web, which surfaces as an Expo LogBox modal that blocks bottom tab-bar taps on the web preview (native mobile is unaffected — this is a warning only).

ui_bugs.issue: Uses react-native-svg <Circle> with originX/originY/rotation transform props. On Expo web preview these serialize to invalid DOM attribute 'transform-origin' causing a Console Error and an Expo LogBox modal overlay that intercepts taps on the bottom tab bar. Chart still renders correctly. Fix: replace originX/originY/rotation with standard SVG transform={`rotate(${rotation} ${size/2} ${size/2})`} which is portable across native and web.

action_items: Fix DonutChart to use standard SVG transform='rotate(deg cx cy)' instead of originX/originY/rotation props to eliminate the 'transform-origin' Console Error and unblock tab-bar interactions on the Expo web preview (src/components/DonutChart.tsx:30). This is a web-preview blocker for automated QA; on device it is only a warning.

(Optional) Add testIDs to the bottom tab bar buttons (e.g. tab-home, tab-transactions, tab-budgets, tab-assistant) — currently only the phosphor icons expose testIDs which makes tab navigation harder to script.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in favor of FastAPI lifespan handlers; still functional but should be migrated.

backend/server.py: assistant_chat calls dashboard_summary(user) which uses Depends internally when invoked over HTTP; direct call works because it just reads user dict, but relying on that coupling is fragile — consider extracting a plain async summary_for_user() helper.
Overall backend code is clean: all endpoints use uuid ids, exclude Mongo _id via clean(), use bcrypt+JWT, and handle soft-deletes consistently.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all major flows verified; DonutChart web warning is the only issue)

seed_data_creation: Registered a throwaway TEST_ user via /api/auth/register to validate seeding produces 3 accounts, 12 transactions, 4 budgets, and 3 goals. Also used pre-seeded aarav@test.com/test123 for UI testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_indicfinance_api.py — 14 tests, ~5s runtime, includes AI chat test that hits gpt-5.4 (~5-8s). Frontend uses expo-router; tab pages are (tabs)/index, /transactions, /budgets, /assistant. Assistant screen uses testIDs assistant-input and assistant-send (NOT chat-input/chat-send). To bypass the DonutChart LogBox modal in automation, navigate directly via window.location.href='/transactions' etc., or dismiss the LogBox first.
rca_of_issue: DonutChart transform-origin bug — RCA: DonutChart.tsx uses react-native-svg's originX/originY/rotation transform shorthand on <Circle>. On the web build, react-native-svg-web converts this to a CSS 'transform-origin' string attribute and passes it as a DOM prop, which React validates as invalid (should be camelCase transformOrigin). React logs a Console Error, Expo LogBox displays it as a modal overlay, and on the small mobile viewport that overlay sits directly on top of the bottom tab bar, blocking taps. Reproduction: open web preview → login → dashboard renders donut → LogBox modal appears → tapping bottom tabs is intercepted. Mitigation: replace the props with an explicit SVG transform string, e.g. transform={`rotate(${rotation} ${size/2} ${size/2})`}, which is the standard SVG API supported identically on native and web.
